score.statistical_unit: participant (NOT 112x112 network edges, EEG channels, or temporal windows)
score.failure: Any absent modality, unmeasured variable, or unidentifiable dose coefficient is masked explicitly, never imputed as a new observed outcome
score.model_specificity: M2 prediction supports distinctive theory only if restricted M1 cannot match same held-out observations under comparably justified priors and capacity
score.inference_rule: A restricted M2 held-out score advantage against a limited M1 is NOT unique evidence for external conscious agency; include a comparably expressive source-independent endogenous HMM ceiling and a mechanistic active-inference comparator. Before any ontology promotion require non-observational or intervention-based discriminators.
score.multiple_comparisons: Predeclare primary comparator and control familywise/multiple comparisons; do not select the most flattering M2 contrast post hoc.

known_design_boundaries: Original 2023 uses bolus 20mg DMT vs placebo; nonzero dose-response curve cannot be inferred solely from one active dose
Public AAL MAT and original voxel NIfTI observations are not identical sources
Participant count 20 deposited pairs does not identify n16 static eligible or n13 dynamic
Unmeasured expectancy, participant belief and pharmacokinetic state are not assumed to be observed
Do not use source-defined sample-specific statistics for held-out tuning
No retrospective model family tightening after seeing test results
Existing psychedelic motif Agda operators are finite stipulated transitions (lattice→tunnel→face), not transition kernels estimated from Erowid experience reports

Noah et al 2024 Erowid corpus includes a named Entities category and 1,121 DMT reports; authors' published category proportions are not person-level onsets, no proof of participant recurrence, and no evidence of independent external entities

Hyperfabric sites remain typed by sampling unit, time resolution, archival lineage, measurement status and access rights. Published Erowid category prevalences can support an aggregate report consumer but cannot transport directly to individual temporal recurrence, voxel-neural replay or M2 ontology.

required_mechanistic_steelman: M1a: implement an explicitly bounded active-inference candidate with two distinct prior dimensions: counterfactual richness / depth, and sensory precision / self-other agency attribution, following Mago et al's conceptual account; do not claim authors provided an executable model

M1b: include a generic matched-capacity HMM/state-space observational equivalence ceiling: any finite M2 latent Q/emission-only observation model can be relabelled as an endogenous stochastic latent model with the same observed law
Prespecify culturally conditioned priors, familiarity and expectancy as potential explanatory covariates only if actually collected; unknowns stay unobserved
Account for retrospective temporal ordering uncertainty, interviews/coder reliability, subject overlap and independent cohort provenance

Condition a future report-level theme comparator on substance, dose, preparation, expectations and cultural narrative/selection bias only where permitted and actually observed; do not transform sentence counts into independent people
conditional_predictions: If operational sensory precision/counterfactual depth are measurable and modulated under controlled conditions, a restricted M1a predicts agency-attribution shifts attributable to those variables, with parameter bounds predeclared
Multisensory/3D perceptual development can precede presence onset even in wholly endogenous generative models; temporal ordering alone is not a model discriminator
M1b can exactly emulate a finite fixed-Q hidden-state emission distribution; a generic M2 trace identity thus cannot uniquely identify latent ontology

models.latent_state: finite latent agent-state proposal with fixed-Q nested subset traces and independently grounded observation maps
models.transition: fixed Q across explicitly comparable trace windows under a declared model; dose/condition may change observation/emission maps only unless separate Q(c) model preregistered
fixed_independently: nested observable event sets and their operational measurement map
latent state capacity bound and fixed-Q assumption
which predictions would fail restricted M1
predictions: predeclared first-return/trace consistency on held-out measurable nested event sets
proper predictive distribution on exactly M0/M1 observables
models.falsification: Measured violations of frozen trace law/assumptions within accuracy limits, or no matched held-out predictive advantage against M1
models.nonpromotion: Generic Markov trace identities also hold for ordinary stochastic models; without distinct exclusion of M1 the outcome is nonidentifiability, not agent evidence
extra_adversarial_requirements: Supply a prediction impossible under the predeclared serious endogenous mechanistic M1a, rather than merely outperforming M0
Report a generic matched-capacity M1b HMM observational-equivalence ceiling, with a rational exact counterexample when appropriate
If the distinguishing prediction is concealed-target information, move it into prospective M3 with leakage and blinding controls; no retrospective fMRI or presence report can stand in
Formal fixed-Q nesting constraints must be separately measured and operationally identified across conditions; condition-specific Q(c) changes cannot be hidden under the fixed-Q proof

Any recurring motif Markov attractor or ternary three-cycle is already reproducible by ordinary endogenous stochastic dynamics; a distinct M2 claim needs source-defined transition distributions or independent intervention, not recurring labels alone
